text: Male, adult. Muscular build. Tan skin. Long blonde hair in a thick braid down back. Oval face with prominent brow ridge. Wears brown leather belt with gold buckle, dark loincloth, fur-trimmed boots. Gold hoop earrings, necklace with white teeth-like pendants and central circular pendant. Standing front-facing, arms at sides. Three views shown: front, side, back. Eyes blue. Mouths vary in expression across panels.
